subject: A 4AM confession about Predictify
preview_text: I don't usually write emails like this, but I owe you the truth about what I built and why.
body_paragraphs: I don't usually write emails like this. But it's 4AM, I'm staring at a cold coffee, and I realized I've been hiding the real reason I built Predictify. I was tired of losing bets on hunches and gut feelings, watching my bankroll bleed out on races I couldn't read. So I coded this thing in a fog of exhaustion and obsession, hoping it would save me from myself.

The truth is, I still get nervous before every big race. But now I have a 2AM companion that doesn't guess—it crunches thousands of variables: track conditions, jockey form, weight shifts, even the weather at post time. That's the edge I wanted to give you too.

Open the app and tap any racecard. Look for the Confidence Score next to each horse. That number is the result of an AI that never sleeps, analyzing data you'd never have time to dig through. It's the closest thing to a track insider without leaving your couch.

Tap a race right now. See what the AI sees. P.S. If you want the full analysis—speed ratings, distance tendencies, and live track data—that's what Premium unlocks. It's $12.99 a month, but the first 3 days are on me. No rush, but the next race might be.
